source_row.extraction_instructions: Listing is a single server-rendered WordPress page (redirects from events-courses/all-events-courses/ to training-careers/courses-events-calendar/) with all upcoming cards as .js-card blocks giving title, a human date chip (.tag__date), 0-2 .card__location-time-text spans and a one-line .card__copy description -- generic DOM walker finds 0 cards, hence list_shells_override(). Detail pages are plain WordPress under /courses-and-events/<slug>/: title in h1, location/time in .article-page-banner__event-item spans, fees in .article-page-banner__member-item ('Member fee: GBP60' / 'Non-member fee: GBP90', the latter often CSS-hidden but present via textContent), and the ONE clean description paragraph in .article-page-banner__copy. No CPD points published on any probed page and no schema.org Event JSON-LD -- the listing date chip is the only date source; a title regex recovers a second day for spans like '7 & 8 December 2026'. Register CTAs point at the iHub ASP.NET registrar (ihub.rcophth.ac.uk) but our own page stays the stable source_url.

registry_comment: RCOphth (32) — WordPress listing override (generic walker finds 0 cards) + plain WordPress detail pages, no anti-bot

spot_check.site_says: title '7 & 8 December 2026', listing chip '7 December 2026', Edinburgh

concerns: Annual Congress (linked from nav as /training-careers/courses-events-calendar/annual-congress/) is a separate flagship subsite, NOT a card on the listing page walked here -- it needs its own handling (likely detail_is_multipage) if it should be onboarded; out of scope for this build.

iHub Event_Search.aspx portal (ihub.rcophth.ac.uk) mentioned in recon as a secondary listing surface was not walked -- the 12 cards on the WordPress calendar page appear to be the complete upcoming set (each Register CTA does point into iHub per-event), but if iHub ever lists events not mirrored on the WP page they'd be missed.

No CPD point figures were observed on any of the 12 live cards/detail pages (only a generic 'Approval of CPD points' nav link exists site-wide) -- cpd_points will be None across this entire source; this is real absence of data, not an extraction gap, but worth knowing since RCOphth is a Royal College source where CPD accreditation is usually expected.

'Introduction to Ophthalmic Surgery course' reruns on 4 separate dates as 4 fully independent URLs/rows (each with its own iHub EventKey), not a single course+sessions parent -- intentional, since the source itself treats them as distinct bookable pages, but flagging in case the product later wants them grouped.

event_format='online' detection and city/region inference were only exercised on the 12 live cards (1 Zoom webinar, ~9 in-person with a plain city name banner, 1 location-less workshop backstopped via title). No multi-word street-address venue was seen in the live feed to test the 'strip to city' logic against; if RCOphth later publishes a full postal address in the banner, the current code takes the whole string as city/venue verbatim.
